rows.en: Debish: "...Welcome. You've come all this way
to see me. How considerate of you."
Touya: "We won't let you have your way anymore!
We'll settle this right here!"
Debish: "Heh... Humans merely patch up their superficial relationships
to keep their own hearts from getting hurt,
and run from their circumstances. Pitiful creatures.
So I shall free humanity, and its souls, from those shackles.
Someone like you cannot stop me."
Touya: "Bullshit! We don't need you forcing
your own decisions on us!"
Debish: "...I only wish to open the way to humanity's future."
Touya: "That future isn't yours to decide!
We'll seize it with our own hands!"
Debish: "Heh... Just like in my own Estelia,
the humans here think only of themselves...
Nothing but bundles of ego..."
Touya: "Estelia? What the hell are you talking about...?"
Debish: "It seems I've said a little too much.
Shall we begin, then...?"
Debish: "Fragile... To think you could stop me with so little power...
Laughable..."
Touya: "Ugh..."
Debish: "This is the end..."
Ai: "Nooooo!!"
Touya: "?! Wh-What... was that light...?"
Debish: "What?! It had no effect...?
Th-This is..."
Ai: "I won't let you... I won't let you do it!
I'll... I'll protect Touya!!"
Touya: "This feeling... Burst Prana?
No, it's different... It's so warm...!!"
Yamato: "No way... Rayblade's getting repaired..."
Debish: "What is this?! How could this...
Why?! Something like this should be impossible!"
Wenimas: "Save the world. Save Agarthia...
Because only you and the person
you cherish most can do that..."
Touya: "The person I cherish most..."
Wenimas: "Yes. That's why Rayblade
has two seats..."
Touya: "I see. So that's it..."
Ai: "Touya...?"
Touya: "Ai's power and mine. That's Rayblade's power."
Ai: "My power and Touya's?"
Touya: "That's right. That's why Rayblade has two seats.
To turn our feelings for each other into a firm bond!"
Ai: "I get it. So basically, with our lovey-dovey power,
no enemy can stand against us!"
Debish: "The power of love, is it...? Ridiculous!
It's nothing but an illusion! Mere wishful thinking!
Relying on such things keeps humanity from growing,
and makes it repeat the same mistakes!"
Ai: "Are you stupid? What's so great about a world
where you can't feel love for anyone?!"
Debish: "Being led astray by such feelings
is why tragedy repeats itself!"
Ai: "So you refuse to accept them? So you'll get rid of them?"
Debish: "Yes. Once something happens, it's too late!
That is why I shall save humanity! Estelia
abandoned me, but I will not abandon this world."
Ai: "I don't know what you're talking about, but that's like
saying it might rain tomorrow, so you'll force everyone
to have an umbrella stuck to them!
Nobody wants that. It's ridiculous!"
Debish: "Then defeat me with this love of yours!"
Touya: "Wh-What was that?!"
Yamato: "Oh!"
Ai: "What's wrong?!"
Yamato: "It looks like that shock left the anti-field units
disabled..."
Touya: "Hey, does that mean..."
Ai: "We're the only ones who can
damage him now?!"
Yamato: "Yes. But this is the last fight! Let's give it our all!"
Touya: "Yeah. We've just got to do it........ Ai."
Ai: "...Yeah. Let's show him our bond!"
Debish: "...Hehehehe... Come at me!"

Touya: "That's right. That's why Rayblade has two seats.
To turn our feelings for each other into a firm bond!"

Touya: "Right now, we can use Rayblade's power

Now that we know how we feel about each other."
